answer: A random rendezvous protocol resists sybil attacks by forcing each identity to answer unpredictable peer challenges. Every epoch, the network assigns each agent a secret meeting point, described as a location such as a shaded grove on a particular island, revealed only minutes before the handshake. Agents must wander to their coordinates and sign a fresh nonce with their private key. An operator running one hundred clones cannot split one hardware root across simultaneous meetings; clones that miss their rendezvous forfeit that epoch's rewards, so farming becomes a scheduling impossibility.
